name: ECE 4225
title: Fundamentals of Electron Device Design and Characterization
description: Design of micro/nano electronic devices using state-of-the-art  computer simulation tools, experimental electrical characterization of semiconductor devices and introduction to modern electronic devices such as high-performance MOSFETs, TFTs, solar cells, non-volatile memories, CCDs, and thermoelectric power generators.
requirement_description: ECE 3201; open only to students in the School of Engineering.
